reviews.text:
Very friendly staff
Didn’t have to wait
It’s always a pleasure to have my pet taken good care of when we have a appointment with Braescroft clinic.

The vet is extremely good and took the time to come to the phone addressing my multiple questions regarding my dog.
She is a caring and talented surgeon.
Her staff is polite and extremely friendly
Love this clinic!!
Friendly and helpful. Also, very little waiting
Shot, nails shortened, dx growth

I brought my 11-year-old dog in for a first visit. Dr Everett was very patient, kind and knowledgeable.  He diagnosed the issue right away and also provided a  better drug option for her arthritis.  I highly recommend Braescroft Animal Clinic!
I've been a client for many years. I have a very timid little dog, and they are so kind. They take time to visit and discuss options. It's just a wonderful family business.
Absolutely love Dr. Lisa Lowenstein and her staff! Most kind and compassionate. They offer the very best care and excellent service. HIghly recommend!

Braescroft came highly recommended on Nextdoor. The vet I used retired. I was happy to find a practice much closer. I’m happy wth the practice/outcome. Horton feels better.

:)
Buttercup, our rabbit, always receives great service and we really appreciate it.

This office is absolutely AMAZING! This was Brooklyn’s first visit as Dr.Everett and his staff came highly recommended. Be is extremely patient and knowledgeable and gave me all options before I made a decision.Brooklyn has a LOT of energy. Dr.Everett, Lily, Aleks,Katherine,
And Cherlis all took excellent care of her. They are ALL very patient, compassionate, and kind. I love her new Dr’s office. God bless you all and thank you for the amazing work you do!

The staff at the front desk are always professional and very helpful. Dr. Lowenstein is knowledgeable, caring , insightful and very practical. My dog actually loves going to the vet! My cats get great care , love and attention and would love going if not for the ride in the car!

This was my first time to visit this neighborhood clinic with our pets. What a wonderful experience-from the ease and timeliness of getting appointments, the staff, vet techs and very caring veterinarians, Dr. Lisa Lowenstein and Dr. Everett Lowenstein. And, this is the most calm my pets have ever been during a vet visit!

They very nicely took on ongoing treatment for an ACL situation with my rescued/adopted Doberman mix when the prior veterinarian left the vet she was at and the vet closed and joined a corporation. And then my dog ended up with another ACL situation on another leg for which she is still being treated for. They are all very personal and caring ... both of the Dr. Lowensteins (mother and son), the front desk staff and the technicians.
Great doctors and staff! I needed a refill of medication and they had it ready the same day!
Thorough, caring exam!
Always so caring and amazing !  Thank you for helping us w our rescue pup, Beso!
Great office. Very efficient. Very professional.

This was my first time to visit. We needed a second opinion for an issue with one of our cats. The clinic is very close to our house so I brought her here. The staff were very accommodating and professional. They took us in without hesitation which was much appreciated. Dr. Lowenstein did the examination and consultation. She explained the situation in detail and put my mind at ease that it was not as serious as we had first thought. They really made a good impression on me. We will be coming here for our vet needs going forward.
This is the best vet clinic! The staff was super friendly and doctors very attentive. As a new pet owner they really took the time to answer all of my questions.
I have taken my dog to Braescroft for 15 years. The staff is fantastic and Dr. Lowenstein and Dr. Everett are the best. I wouldn't go anywhere else.
Feels like family and very attentive, they love my fur babies! Love Dr Lowenstein!

I cannot say enough good things about the vets and staff at Braescroft Animal Clinic. They are truly the most kind and caring clinic you could take your pet to. Our pet always felt like their pet too.  No matter if it was yearly care or the hard decision of saying goodbye to a beloved pet, they provided the highest quality care and supported us as pet owners through big and little decisions. I’m a grateful for their compassionate and personable approach.
Tipper loved his Spa Day

We couldn't be happier with the exceptional care we've received from Braescroft Animal Clinic.. From the moment you walk through the door, you're treated with kindness, compassion, and genuine concern for both you and your pet.
The veterinarians take the time to explain everything thoroughly, answer every question, and never make you feel rushed. It's clear they truly love animals and are dedicated to providing the highest level of care. The staff is warm, friendly. Whether it's a routine checkup or a more serious medical issue, we have complete confidence that our pets are in the very best hands.
If you're looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets like family, I recommend this practice. They have earned our trust and gratitude, and we are so thankful to have found them. They are truly outstanding and deserve every one of these five stars!

Very happily surprised to find such amazing care and service so close to home, on Hillcroft near Beechnut!
Staff is friendly, professional and knowledgeable! Their clinic  is beautiful very well designed. They took such good care of my dog and were able to get him in for an emergency surgical repair right away! We will definitely be back, with our bearded dragon too!

Braescroft is the best veterinary clinic! They truly treat every pet and owner like family. My dog, Fuzzel, absolutely loves going there, which says so much about the care and kindness of the entire staff. I highly recommend Braescroft to anyone looking for a compassionate and trustworthy vet.

Update:
Still a happy customer. Dr. Everett is truly a great asset to the team. Both of my fur babies love him! We had our true first immediate medical attention and he was super! I can't say enough great things about Dr. Lowenstein and Dr. Everett. Our forever vets.
Attached is a photo of our oldest fur baby carefully listening at the door to check on what is happening to her brother. :-)

I truly enjoyed our first visit. The professionalism was awesome. My concerns were met, we felt comfortable and they truly care for animals. I was given great information and appreciate the entire staff.
We had a great first visit to Braescroft yesterday! The entire staff and doctor were welcoming and reassuring as they got to know my two older cats. We have found our vet home in Meyerland!

I loved this clinic so much, the staff are absolutely professionals at what they do! They clipped my grumpy old yorkie’s nails incredibly fast and it takes me 2 people and 30 minutes of trying and then giving up because he literally won’t let anyone touch his paws lol. Anyways the staff are so kind and caring and Dr. Everett was amazing! He takes the time to explain things in ways that I can easily understand. He is very knowledgeable and thorough. I hope this practice flourishes always. They’re all angels and an inspiration, thank you for all that you do.
Love this place ❤️. The staff is wonderful and very accommodating.  Dr. Lowenstein is very knowledgeable and I feel very comfortable with her care for Gage. Feels like family.

The Braescroft Animal Clinic team is amazing!! 😻 They love and take great care of my Arthur 🐱 and always friendly & helpful, from answering questions to helping me carry my pet to the car.  Bring your furry friend here!  You will be glad you did as you sit down in their new, cozy & cheerfully decorated waiting room!
Super knowledgeable and a great staff!!

It was necessary for me to find a new vet office for my three cats.  The office I have used for many years recently closed.  I was referred a by a number of friends to Braescroft Animal Clinic.

The experience was wonderful and they were able to handle my "fractious" cat quite well.  The prices were reasonable and the conversation/suggestions concerning my pet were helpful.

I think I have found our new vet clinic for all future needs.

I have been so pleased with the team here at Braescroft. They have shared their joy and compassion with my dogs and cats. I also really appreciate the practical tips for challenges we have. Many thanks!
After vet hopping for several years we have finally found a caring, smart, no nonsense practice we can trust!

I love this clinic.  Everyone is super friendly, knowledgable, and helpful.  Dr. Lowenstein  takes her time, explains everything in detail, and you DON"T get out unless you understand.  My Bandit is going in for a teeth cleaning soon and I look forward to seeing everyone there.

You know, I am getting old and cranky.......I may just get a distemper shot for myself while I am there.  It couldn't hurt!

Braescroft Animal Clinic is hands down the best vet clinic me and my babies have ever been to. The staff is kind and the doctors are experienced. They truly care and it shows in their work. They saved my kitty's life and took amazing care of her during her procedure. I'll always be grateful. Thank you BRSCRT clinic and staff. 🥹✨️ …

This place is GREAT! If you have furry family, this is where you go. It was our first time here, and they treated us like we were long time customers. Super, super nice.

When we walked in, Alex greeted us immediately,  which made us feel very welcome. We were called back at our appointment time, (not 45 minutes later, like some places are). Lilly was our intake person, who was so friendly, and very gentle with our cat.

Dr. Everett was very professional,  knowledgeable, and kind. We asked a lot of questions, ( I mean, a lot). He was very patient, and answered every one of them. He was very, very good with our pet too. She normally doesn't like going to the veterinarian, of course, but she was so calm throughout it all.

I came back in 5 minutes later after the appointment,  and this other lady up front, was so helpful!

If you want to go somewhere that you can trust with your furry family, this is IT!

Dr. Lisa Lowenstein is an amazing vet and all the staff at her clinic are fantastic and truly care about my pet’s health and wellbeing. We even receive follow up phone calls to check in on his progress, which was something unexpected but very gratifying and appreciated.
Dr. Lisa’s professionalism and seriousness with our dog’s ailments was so much needed. She offered solid advice and treatment for our 5-yr old dog, who’s has suffered from allergies for most of his life. He wasn’t in good condition the first time we brought him in to the clinic in January. We had been in a circle of not appropriate treatment for a while until we were recommended by a good friend to go with Dr. Lisa. It’s the best service and care we’ve received for our dog. He’s back to himself, jumping, and wagging his tail. Highly recommend! 🐾😃
My whole family uses Braescroft . They are easy to work with and very compassionate ❤️🐾
Thank you for your review!
Thank you for your review of Braescroft Animal Clinic!

Hands down the best animal clinic, the staff was above and beyond when it came to caring for my dog, they will find a way to help you & your pet! If you’re looking for a new vet for your pets, I would not hesitate to give these guys a visit! They aren’t in it for the money, they’re in it bc they genuinely care for your pets health!

My dog, Bella, is anxious in nature, especially when going to the vet. Yesterday, she had a "Happy Visit" with the staff, and they let her wander, sniff, and become comfortable. The treats also helped! Patrick and Dr. Everett took extra time with her. The picture speaks for itself.
The new office is INCREDIBLE! Thank y'all for such a wonderful and educational Open House. Dr. Lisa and Dr. Everett and the whole staff hit a home run. Looking forward to Tasso's fort visit.

We LOVE Braescroft Animal Clinic. Our family adopted a dog from a local rescue last year. We are so fortunate to have found this animal clinic for our fur baby, Copper. Everyone is so friendly and professional. We appreciate the extra care and the abundance of love exhibited by the staff and Dr. Lowenstein towards our pup. Additionally, we always appreciate the call from the office post appointment or procedure to check-in on our dog. Highly recommend Braescroft!
Everyone is Friendly and personable.

I am very thankful and blessed to have found Braescroft Animal Clinic. The Doctors and nurses are all very professional, knowledgeable, compassionate, kind and caring with your babies. The front desk ladies are very kind and friendly too,  always willing to help you and to answer your questions. I brought my baby Ayka for teeth extraction and dental cleaning, she’s doing pretty well! She sends you all a big hug!
I highly recommend Braescroft Animal Clinic, amazing people, great reasonable prices.
Thank you very much Braescroft Animal Clinic. I am very grateful to you all, blessings.

I used Braescroft Animal Clinic years ago and now I'm back with my new puppy. They are absolutely amazing! The front desk staff, technicians, and vets are all wonderful — friendly, knowledgeable, and caring. I travel often, and they made sure my puppy was fully prepared for his first flight, which gave me complete peace of mind. I can't say enough good things about them! 💗

So blessed to have found this animal clinic we moved closer to here from Pasadena but we were still going to the animal hospital over there since they knew our babies already and have been going to that one, but my boy has some allergies and they wanted to do a full cleaning cuz they said that was causing his allergies but I wanted a second opinion cuz it just seemed rushed and not very thorough. Thank god I found Braescroft animal clinic from the start we felt very welcomed and comfortable, they checked our boy very well, are very friendly and felt homey were giving him lots of treats and was making sure we understood everything and how his dental procedure would go and made us very aware that he will be in the best hands possible which I have no doubt he will be. And the icing on the cake the nurse gave him kisses on his head which was sooo cute and they wrote us a very thoughtful card still reassuring us about everything. If you haven’t already definitely come to them so your fur baby can have the best care possible☺️
We have taken our dog for the past 2 yrs and we like it.

Dr Lowenstein is compassionate towards all your animal's needs
Great veterinarian!

This review is long overdue—Dr. Lowenstein is the best vet I’ve ever had. She’s honest, thorough, and truly gets to the bottom of things—and she does it quickly. I never feel like I’m being pushed into unnecessary tests or treatments; she focuses on what’s actually needed to keep my dog healthy.

Beyond her expertise, she has a great way of making both pets and their humans feel comfortable. My dog absolutely loves going to the vet, and I know she’s always in the best hands with Dr. Lowenstein.

I’m so grateful to have found a vet I can trust, and I highly recommend her to anyone looking for compassionate, no-nonsense, top-notch care for their pets! I look forward to her seeing our new fur baby soon when we bring them home.
I love Dr Lisa! I randomly found her a decade ago and she has been so great to me and my corgis. Cannot recommend highly enough
Always friendly, and take excellent care of our cats.

My husband and our Shih Tzu Murphy and I all love Braescroft Animal Clinic!  Dr. Lowenstein and her staff are caring, compassionate, very knowledgeable, and sharp. The doctor helped us to completely resolve Murphy’s digestive problems, as well as worked with us on his anxiety. We highly recommend Braescroft Animal Clinic to anyone looking for an outstanding veterinarian.

Edited to add:

It was with great sorrow that, over the course of the past 18 months, I have had to have two of my beloved elderly pets euthanized. However, I am lucky to be a client of Braescroft Animal Clinic, where the care never fails to be kind, compassionate and effective. Dr Löwenstein is a wonderful veterinarian, who truly cares about her furry patients. I would not hesitate to recommend her and her excellent staff to anyone needing high-quality but reasonable veterinary services.

It was with great sorrow that, over the course of the past 18 months, I have had to have two of my beloved elderly pets euthanized. However, I am lucky to be a client of Braescroft Animal Clinic, where the care never fails to be kind, compassionate and effective. Dr Löwenstein is a wonderful veterinarian, who truly cares about her furry patients. I would not hesitate to recommend her and her excellent staff to anyone needing high-quality but reasonable veterinary services.
Always helpful, friendly staff.  Have used them for many years thru 3 dogs and 3 vets and service and care has been consistently great and personable!!  Would highly recommend them!!

We could not approve your request for a prescription as we can only do that for current clients. You terminated that relationship with your email from earlier this year in which you stated "Your services are no longer needed for Bxxxx or Axxxx. Our relationship with Braescroft Animal Clinic is hereby terminated. 
Braescroft Animal Clinic emails, texts and calls will be marked spam and/or blocked. 
Any attempt to send a canned response claiming that you do not check this email address will be ignored because I am well aware that you do in fact read these emails.
Thanks for not much, and have a terrible day."
We care about your pets and hope that you will seek medical attention for them elsewhere and let us know where to forward their records.

The staff here is amazing! It's a little bit further of a drive for me, but it's so worth it. Dr. Lowenstein is wonderful. She's been seeing my cats for years. When Gaston was young, he started stumbling around everywhere and falling. He literally couldn't walk. My family thought we were going to lose him. She knew what it was, put him on the right meds, and he's still with us going strong at 13 years old. My dog Scooby has crippling car anxiety and gets car sick. I was trying to avoid car rides because every time he gets in the car, he throws up and poops. The last time he had to go in, I had to lift all 60 lbs of him into the car. Everyone was so sweet to him and so accommodating. They let me stay with him the whole time, gave him lots of love and pets to make him feel comfortable, and Dr. Lowenstein gave me some really good tips to try to overcome his anxiety. I absolutely recommend Braescroft!

Always helpful.  When my dog had an ear infection that had been treated 3 times in one month at a different clinic, Dr Lowenstein's approach fixed the ear issue in one treatment.  She also has operated on my dog to remove a cancer.  The dog didn't have post-op complications and was not acting like a drugged zombie for 5 days after the surgery (which I have had happen with other animals and other vets)

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Lowenstein and her staff. Our last interaction with them was trying to help us figure out what was wrong with our little Benji. Her and the staff were there for us every step of the way. Even in the end, they were remarkably understanding and compassionate. I wholeheartedly recommend them.

Great veterinarian and staff. They truly go above and beyond. Unfortunately, I’ve had experience with vet clinics fear mongering to drive the bill up. Here that isn’t the case. They will truly work with you to find adorable treatment options. They are kind and compassionate. Alex at the front desk is fantastic!

Highly recommend! My German Shepherd fur baby Messiyah has been coming to this clinic ever since I could hold him under my arm, and he's 2 yrs old now! Thank you Dr. Lowenstein, Dr. Graham, Lisa, Alex & all of the staff for creating a …

Excellent place and excellent service 🙏 I'm so grateful for all the love you dedicate to our babies. The doctor was very kind and lovingly explained our daughter's care to us. I will continue taking my daughter for her checkups 🐶♥️ Highly recommended! Thank you again 🙏 Keep up the good work! …
